subject: trouble running writeRegions on GLAD results from multiple runs

messages.author: ecc3d0294e521eb5
messages.subject: trouble running writeRegions on GLAD results from multiple runs
parts:
I just ran the GLAD algorithm for a large dataset across multiple
computers and then gathered the results together and used writeRegions
to summarize the results. After starting to run writeRegions, I
noticed that aroma.affymetrix processed about half of the GLAD result
files, but for the other half it wanted to run the GLAD fit all over
again.

Looking at the GLAD result files, I saw two types of file names
characterized by a different string at the end:
<sample_name>250k,chr<n>,ca9eae8bf1f36ac1c9e9b2b07c9ad456.xdr
<sample_name>250k,chr<n>,e971ee4d7c9c0ca55806b42dea182e9b.xdr

All of the samples with the second type of file name failed to be read
by the writeRegions call. This was not exclusive, however, as some of
the other samples failed as well.

Please let me know what I'm doing wrong.

Thanks
